# Grupo Castro Fallas

> Grupo Castro Fallas coordinates customs brokerage and cargo logistics for businesses operating in Costa Rica and regional trade routes. Service scope, availability, transit conditions, and pricing depend on the shipment and must be confirmed with the company.

## Company

- [Home](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/): Company overview and logistics services.
- [Services](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/servicios): Customs brokerage, bonded storage coordination, general warehousing, consolidated cargo, and transport services.
- [About Grupo Castro Fallas](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/nosotros): Company information.

## Service pages

- [Maritime freight](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/servicios/transporte-maritimo): International ocean freight coordination to and from Costa Rica.
- [Land freight](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/servicios/transporte-terrestre): International land freight and regional connections.
- [Air freight](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/servicios/transporte-aereo): International air freight coordination.
- [International transport](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/servicios/transporte-internacional): International maritime, land, and air transport options.
- [Local transport](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/servicios/transporte-local): Local transport coordination in Costa Rica with Neriteka and Castro Fallas.
- [Panama–Costa Rica transport](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/servicios/transporte-panama-costa-rica): Land freight coordination between Panama and Costa Rica.
- [Bonded storage](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/servicios/almacenamiento-fiscal): Coordination subject to customs rules and authorized-facility availability.
- [General warehousing](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/servicios/bodegaje-general): General cargo storage coordination.
- [Customs brokerage](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/servicios/agenciamiento-aduanal): Customs documentation and procedure coordination in Costa Rica.
- [Cargo consolidation](https://www.logisticacastrofallas.com/servicios/consolidadora-de-carga): LCL and LTL consolidated cargo options.

## Contact

- [Email the commercial team](mailto:comercial@castrofallas.com)

## Service conditions

Service descriptions are general information, not a quote or a guarantee of availability. Confirm route, cargo requirements, scope, and pricing with Grupo Castro Fallas before booking.
